metadata.title: Getting Started: Login to System
metadata.description: Learn how to login to IoT Monitoring System and navigate the dashboard
metadata.author: System Administrator

sections.title: Accessing the Login Page
sections.content:
Step 1: Open Your Browser

Navigate to the IoT Monitoring System URL provided by your administrator.

The login page will display with the following fields:

  • Username or Email
  • Password
  • Remember Me checkbox (optional)

sections.title: Entering Your Credentials
sections.content:
Step 2: Enter Login Information

Enter your username or email address in the first field.

Enter your password in the second field.

Tip: Make sure your Caps Lock is off to avoid password errors.

sections.title: Logging In
sections.content:
Step 3: Click Login Button

Click the Login button to access the system.

If your credentials are correct, you will be redirected to the dashboard.

If there's an error, you'll see a message indicating the problem.

sections.title: First Time Setup
sections.content:
Step 4: Complete Profile (First Login)

If this is your first login, you may be prompted to:

  • Change your password
  • Complete your profile information
  • Accept terms and conditions

Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the setup.
